name: Touch of Faith (Mythic)
body:
Gods and spirits increased their influence on your life when you gained mythic power.

Prerequisite(s): Touch of Fate.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional revelation from the mystery tied to Touch of Fate for every five levels you have beyond 5th. For the first revelation you selected with the non-mythic version of this feat, use your full character level to determine its effect; you can select and use your other revelations as if you were an oracle of your character level –2.
